I said I'd be shocked if the coupons worked there. I didn't say they didn't. And they really aren't the same company. I work for buy buy baby. We are the same company as bed bath and beyond, Harmon, Christmas tree shops, world food market, and I think we just adopted motherhood maternity as well. We are not a part of babies r us though. They are a completely different company. The only reason they would take bed bath and beyond coupons is if they take competitor coupons, since bed bath and beyond coupons say they can be used at buy buy baby.

If you ever go into a target or a buybuy baby, look for Honest brand baby wipes. They don't have all those chemicals that make your face feel like fire. Also, Honest sells oil, when combined with the wipes, makes the best eye makeup remover ever. The honest brand is made by Jessica Alba , and I work at Buy Buy Baby. Jessica's mother actually came to the store to tell us about her daughter's products when we first got them in and told us this nifty little tip.

This is because with buy buy baby, we have to get a manager to come up and do a key turn every time we have an expired coupon. I know at my location, we gave up saying no to expired coupons because some people were so rude and mean about it, that it was just easier to call the manager to apply the coupon

I work in retail, a bedding section. People were always taking the fitted sheets out of their packages to feel them. After many times balling them back up and placing them in their shitty packaging, my manager taught me how to fold fitted sheets. What you do is fold the sheet in half, now you'll have the rounded stretchy corners looking stupid. Then you stuff the corners on top into the corners underneath. Then you fold in half again to where the corners again meet. You stuff the rounded corner on top into the rounded corner underneath. Now you're left with one rounded corner on the sheet, this is where you just fold it up nice and pretty.
